

Other Typst packages to write pseudocode include [lovelace](https://typst.app/universe/package/lovelace) (featured on Typst Universe), [algorithmic](https://typst.app/universe/package/algorithmic), [algo](https://typst.app/universe/package/algo), and [ez-algo](https://typst.app/universe/package/ez-algo).


I initially developed this package in 2024, to write my PhD thesis in Typst, but I only decided to publish in on the Typst Universe in 2026.
The idea to leverage Typst's list customization for pseudocode typesetting did not actually come from lovelace,
